description: Jordan's Department of Statistics publishes the tables of the 2015 Population and Housing Census as bilingual English and Arabic PDFs on one page. Twelve building tables count buildings by occupancy, type, main material of external walls, year of laying foundations, housing units per building and number of floors, by urban and rural area and governorate. Thirty one housing unit tables cover occupancy, tenure, rooms, rent, and two utility tables. Table 2.17 splits occupied housing units, households and persons by main source of drinking water (public network, filter at home, tank, rain water or well, bottled filtered water, artesian well, spring); table 2.18 does the same for type of heating (central, kerosene or diesel, electric, gas, air conditioner, wood or coal, none). Coverage is national: the census counted 9,453,124 persons in 1,953,194 households; 1,010,498 housing units drew their main drinking water from the public network, and 829,374 were heated mainly by gas heaters. Format and access: free PDF downloads, no registration, plus a census metadata workbook and a housing conditions report; a PxWeb databank exists but its database list shows no census folder. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: governorate level only; PDF tables need extraction. Simulation uses: water supply dependence and heating fuel mix for network and energy demand models, and building age and material for seismic exposure. Related records: the Palestine completed buildings census data and the Israel census 2022 statistical area data.
